resources.string: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ordini ( ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ProviderID INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, Data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date(\'now\')), PagaBase REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, RiscossiContanti REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PagaExtra REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, Mancia REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ManciaContanti REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, NumeroOrdini INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(NumeroOrdini > 0), TempoImpiegato INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(TempoImpiegato > 0), PagaTotale REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PagaOraria REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, StartTime TEXT DEFAULT \'00:00:00\', EndTime TEXT DEFAULT \'00:00:00\', OrderStrategy INTEGER DEFAULT 0, BatchMasterOrderID INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, ristorante TEXT DEFAULT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(ProviderID) REFERENCES Providers(ID) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "MonthlySummaries" ( "id" INTEGER, "document_number" TEXT, "month" TEXT, "month_number" INTEGER, "year" INTEGER, "tax_regime" NUMERIC, "ordini_lordo" REAL, "ordini_ritenuta_acconto" TEXT, "ordini_importo_ritenuta" REAL, "ordini_iva" TEXT, "ordini_importo_iva" REAL, "ordini_totale" REAL, "integrazioni_lordo" REAL, "integrazioni_ritenuta_acconto" TEXT, "integrazioni_importo_ritenuta" REAL, "integrazioni_iva" TEXT, "integrazioni_importo_iva" REAL, "integrazioni_totale" REAL, "mance_lordo" REAL, "mance_ritenuta_acconto" TEXT, "mance_importo_ritenuta" REAL, "mance_iva" TEXT, "mance_importo_iva" REAL, "mance_totale" REAL, "totale_lordo" REAL, "totale_ritenuta_acconto" TEXT, "totale_importo_ritenuta" REAL, "totale_iva" TEXT, "totale_importo_iva" REAL, "totale_totale" REAL, "pagamenti_contanti" REAL, "totale_dovuto" REAL, PRIMARY KEY("id" AUTOINCREMENT) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DailyOrders ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, monthly_summary_id INTEGER, date TEXT, number_of_orders INTEGER, total_gross REAL, FOREIGN KEY(monthly_summary_id) REFERENCES MonthlySummaries(id) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Providers ( ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, Name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE )

CREATE TABLE "ordini_new" ( "ID" INTEGER, "ProviderID" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "Data" DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT (date(\'now\')) CHECK(("Data" IS date("Data", \'+0 days\'))), "PagaBase" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "RiscossiContanti" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "PagaExtra" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "Mancia" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ManciaContanti" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "NumeroOrdini" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("NumeroOrdini" > 0), "TempoImpiegato" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("TempoImpiegato" > 0), "PagaTotale" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "PagaOraria" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY("ID" AUTOINCREMENT), CONSTRAINT "Ordinante" FOREIGN KEY("ProviderID") REFERENCES "Providers"("ID") )

INSERT INTO "ordini_new" ( "ID", "ProviderID", "Data", "PagaBase", "RiscossiContanti", "PagaExtra", "Mancia", "ManciaContanti", "NumeroOrdini", "TempoImpiegato", "PagaTotale", "PagaOraria" ) SELECT "ID", 1 AS "ProviderID", COALESCE("Data", date(\'now\')) AS "Data", COALESCE("PagaBase", 0) AS "PagaBase", 0 AS "RiscossiContanti", COALESCE("PagaExtra", 0) AS "PagaExtra", COALESCE("Mancia", 0) AS "Mancia", 0 AS "ManciaContanti", CASE WHEN "NumeroOrdini" IS NULL OR "NumeroOrdini" <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE "NumeroOrdini" END AS "NumeroOrdini", CASE WHEN "TempoImpiegato" IS NULL OR "TempoImpiegato" <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE "TempoImpiegato" END AS "TempoImpiegato", COALESCE("PagaTotale", 0) AS "PagaTotale", COALESCE("PagaOraria", 0) AS "PagaOraria" FROM "ordini"
SELECT ID, NumeroOrdini, PagaOraria FROM ordini WHERE ID > ?
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS InviteCode (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Subscriptions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, start_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, end_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1)
